name: squeeze_floor_inf_rejected_even_when_no_squeeze
description: AC-1 / M-2 (defense in depth): a non-finite floor is rejected at entry UNCONDITIONALLY -- even when para_armed=False AND breakeven_locked=False so the clamp would never fire. A mistuned non-finite parameter is invalid regardless of whether it is used this tick (mirrors the multiplier's unconditional <=0 rejection). squeeze_floor is the string sentinel 'inf'.
derivation: squeeze_floor is +Inf and both flags are False. The entry _reject_non_finite guard fires BEFORE the branch check, so the ValueError is raised even though the squeeze (and its clamp) never execute this call.
